verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these seven qualifications for graduation.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sikkhāsamādāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiñca sikkhāsamādāne avigatapemo,
verses.english: It’s when a mendicant has a keen enthusiasm to undertake the training …

verses.pali: dhammanisantiyā tibbacchando hoti āyatiñca dhammanisantiyā avigatapemo,
icchāvinaye tibbacchando hoti āyatiñca icchāvinaye avigatapemo,
paṭisallāne tibbacchando hoti āyatiñca paṭisallāne avigatapemo,
vīriyārambhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiñca vīriyārambhe avigatapemo,
satinepakke tibbacchando hoti āyatiñca satinepakke avigatapemo,
diṭṭhipaṭivedhe tibbacchando hoti āyatiñca diṭṭhipaṭivedhe avigatapemo.
verses.english: to penetrate theoretically. And they don’t lose these desires in the future.
These are the seven qualifications for graduation.”
